statement: Video is a 3D print checklist to maximize skilling prints and the prerequisites for bigger prints; it is a no-lab checklist.
King of food build uses food effect percent but is late game; this checklist sticks to the efficiency build for new players.
Alchemy yellow bubble 10 gives printer size percent per upgrade so higher level means higher prints.
Snow slurry vial gives more printer size percent.
Arcade golden balls bonus in rotation gives a sample size option for purchase.
Staple stamp drops from a few world 3 enemies (frost flakes sheepie sur stash cheese xylobones crystal cattle) and possibly world 3 coliseum bronze chest.
First bonus of the construction salt lick build gives a bigger sample percent.
World 3 merit shop has a merit that gives sample percent.
Squire talent Super Samples increases printing sample percent for that character only.
Maestro talent Printer Go Brr gives chance to print x hours and percent to reset on cooldown for spamming prints.
Maestro has a family bonus that gives printer sample size percent.
Save gems to buy the crystal 3D printer which gives an extra print slot for twice as many prints.
Max your star talent Printer Sample to 100 for increased gains per level.
Refer to his PO box guide to set up the PO box for prints.
Boost food: icing iron bites gifty bread stained pearls golden peanuts potent decent average small life potions and golden jam to use hearty diggy bubble.
Depending on food slots prioritize mining speed and golden foods first then finish with health foods to utilize hearty diggy bubble.
Star signs to use: dwarfo beardis and og skiller.
Major equipment: viking helmet dirty coal miner pants cavern trekkers and eventually rough rockers and rex rings or serrated rex rings.
Use time stew and persephone banquet.
If you have hydron comatose use it (garbled).
Premium hats and wings (silly suzer cap angel wings) are only if you have them and not a necessity.
Prayers: dimwit and royal sampler.
Read the curse before committing to the royal sampler prayer.
Trophy blunder hero; cards: amarok chaotic troll voidor dementia ore plateau luster ore bunny and chaotic cheese.
If you lack those cards run iron ore mammoth and love you light or strength cards; test easy vs hard resources card set for most bubble.
Wyoming blood for multi-ore chance percent: cap increase to 300 percent.
Equip the highest pick you can.
Do not use the poopy pickaxe for 3D prints; it is incredibly slow and will kill your prints.
Run diamond honker or time candy keychain.
Ovals: gold square mining power silver circle mining power and platinum hexagon mining.
Ovals are completely optional; alternatively use efon or amarok ovals.
Take chaotic cheese card because you use the health shrine during mining prints which raises health percent feeding hearty diggy bubble.
This is a guide to avoid forgetting things and is the route he usually takes for his prints; many ways exist.
